description: This PHP class 'FormatWithNationality' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It formats entity values by retrieving and returning the name of a nationality from the 'NationalityService' based on an ID. The class handles lazy initialization of the service and provides a method to get the formatted nationality name or null if not found.

classes.name: FormatWithNationality
classes.description: A class that formats a given entity value by converting it into a nationality name using a service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the nationality name corresponding to the provided ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the NationalityService instance.
